seoContent.title: Cyprus Events Guide
seoContent.summary: Kıbrıs Etkinlik brings concerts, festivals, theatre and nightlife across Northern Cyprus into one place.
seoContent.p1: Kıbrıs Etkinlik brings together concerts, festivals, theatre, stand-up nights, nightlife and sports across Cyprus. From Nicosia to Kyrenia, Famagusta to İskele — find what's on near you.
seoContent.p2: Planning your weekend? Wondering what's on today? Filter by district to find nearby events, or browse by category — concerts, festivals, family activities, art & culture and more.
seoContent.p3: We are an event discovery platform, not a ticket seller. Event detail pages link you to official ticket and reservation partners.

footer.aboutText: Kıbrıs Etkinlik is an independent platform helping you find events across Northern Cyprus.
